findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: holiday_calendar, get_my_brand, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, get_suara_replies, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights · Private data: connect_social_account · Public sink: make_sample_posts, best_time_to_post, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, approve_post, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: holiday_calendar, get_my_brand, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, get_suara_replies, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights · Private data: connect_social_account · Public sink: make_sample_posts, best_time_to_post, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, approve_post, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
